授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
This class will be taught entirely in English.
This class is open to anyone interested in understanding the role of law in a fast-changing, technology-driven global society.
If you have any questions about the class, please send an email to Mark FENWICK -
mark@law.kyushu-u.ac.jp

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: グローバル社会の2つの特徴は、（i）新技術の誕生、（ii）世界市場と多国籍企業の出現、成長が行われていることです。 このコースの目的は、これらのグローバル社会の特徴が作り出した法的および政治的問題のいくつかを調べることです。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Two of the defining features of a global society are (i) the growth of new technology and (ii) the emergence of global markets and multinational companies operating in multiple countries. This course will examine some of the legal problems connected to these developments, focusing on various human rights issues.
In this course, we will examine the role of law in an international society, focusing on fundamental - or human - rights and emerging technologies. Specifically, we will examine how the law is disrupted by fast-paced technological change in the fields of medical, privacy, and employment law. By the end of the course, students will have a better understanding of the complexity of modern legal debates in these fields and the difficult policy challenges that the law must deal with in an age of exponential technological development and moral pluralism.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Global society, new technologies, medical law, technology corporations
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
There are no pre-requisites for this course. The course is open to anyone interested in understanding global society.
No background knowledge is required to take this course. The course is open to anyone interested in this topic.

rows: Course Overview
An introduction to the class content and class rules.
No prior work necessary.
In Vitro Fertilization & the Right to a Family 1
In this class, we will discuss some recent decisions of the European Court of Human Rights on IVF treatment and the right to a family.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Pre-Genetic Testing & Savior Siblings 1
In this class, we will discuss recent cases of the European Court of Human Rights on savior siblings.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Pre-Genetic Testing & Savior Siblings 2
In this class, we will discuss some recent US cases on savior siblings.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Trans Rights & the Law
In this class, we will discuss some recent UK cases on transsexuals and the law and the proposed reform of the UK law on changing assigned sex.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
The Changing Meaning of Death & the Law 1
This class will examine the right to die and euthanasia, focusing on some decisions of the European Court of Human Rights.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
The Changing Meaning of Death & the Law 2
This class will examine the right to die and euthanasia, focusing on some recent US cases.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Separating Conjoined Twins
This class will examine legal cases in involving conjoined twins where there is a class between parental wish NOT to separate and doctors' wish to separate.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Privacy & the Right to be Forgotten 1
This class will examine the right to be forgotten in European law, focusing in particular on the right to control what information Google searches reveal about you.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Privacy & the Right to be Forgotten 2
This class will examine privacy and the right to be forgotten in US law.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Workplace Surveillance & the Employer’s Right to Monitor Employees 1
This class will examine recent decisions of the European Court of Human Rights on the right of employees to monitor their employees.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Mass Surveillance
This class will examine mass surveillance of its citizens using digital technologies.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Twitter & the Limits of Freedom of Speech
This class will examine recent UK cases on freedom of speech on social media.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Human Rights Abuses on the Global Supply Chain
This class will examine the issue of human rights abuses on the global supply chain and attempts to improve corporate behavior.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
Class Review
This class will review the main themes of the course.
Reading materials provided on MOODLE.
